title: Write your own concepts
description:
A concept is a named list of things a type must be able to do, written as a `requires` expression.

Write two:

- `Printable`: a value of the type can be sent to a `std::ostream` with `<<`.
- `HasSize`: an object of the type has a `.size()` member whose result converts to `std::size_t`.

Then use them: write `std::size_t sizeOf(const HasSize auto& container)` that returns `container.size()`.

```cpp
template <typename T>
concept Printable = requires(std::ostream& out, const T& value) { out << value; };
```
